$comment: Step -> model routing for ai/core.mjs callModel(), chosen by the benchmark in ai/bench/ (2026-10-15; tables, numbers and reasons: ai/research/benchmark.md). Every thinking step runs on Claude Opus 5.5 (the user's preference, confirmed or matched by the measurements), at the reasoning effort the benchmark found best for that step: observe medium (end to end on the picture cases, 2 samples x 26: pass 0.96 vs 0.90 at low, +11 s), plan medium, refine medium, edit low (for plan, high was no better and slower; for edits, medium/high changed things the user did not ask for). Route: claude-group (Anthropic-native: prompt caching of the catalog, 0 errors in ~1,500 bench calls). Fallbacks: the same model on AWS Bedrock (an independent backend; no strict json_schema there, which these steps do not use), then a different family measured as the best fast stand-in for that step. retries 1 per route: a hung or failing route moves on to an independent backend quickly instead of retrying it twice. timeoutMs is about 3x the slowest answer measured for the primary; budgetMs leaves room for one fallback. models: per-route quirks (vision, prompt caching via cache_control on the system prompt, params the route rejects). 2026-10-15 (repair): plan timeoutMs 180 → 300 s (a classroom Rube Goldberg photo's plan took 145 s on its second try after the first was cut at 180 s), and every step streams on the routes that stream their thinking as it goes (quirk stream: true: claude-group, the OpenAI group; Bedrock buffers the whole answer, so it is called plainly): an attempt with no progress for idleTimeoutMs (90 s) is dropped at once and the next try or route starts, while a long plan that keeps thinking may use its whole timeout. 2026-10-15 (round 2, ai/research/benchmark.md §13): "rate" is refine's rate-only final check (payload rate_only: true): the same system prompt as refine (so it reads the prompt cache), effort low, a short answer {score_0_10, issues}; observe.simpleParams is the effort for a picture the request calls a sketch or a drawing (low: as good on the bench's sketches, about half the time). Quirk cacheTtl "1h" (claude-group and Bedrock Opus 5.5, checked through the gateway): the static system prompts stay cached for an hour instead of 5 minutes, so the first build after a pause reads the 44k-token catalog prompt from the cache.
